messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-4762 — infer-prod p50 latency > 250ms (service: inference-prod). Triggered at 07:13 UTC.
pagerduty: PagerDuty created incident INC-4762 (severity: P2) — automatic paging to eng-oncall.
alice: ack — I'm looking. grabbing logs and hpa state.
incident-bot: ACK recorded by alice.
maria: I'm shadowing until 07:30 UTC and can take over if needed.
devon: seeing big spike from eu-west-1, request queue depth up on worker-gpu-pool-2. Autoscale didn't react fast enough.
alice: logs show intermittent 'NV_RUN_TIMEOUT' and long queue wait times.
alice: running `kubectl -n inference describe hpa worker-gpu-pool-2` — HPA at 90% target, maxReplicas=8.
devon: bumping maxReplicas to 12 temporarily: `kubectl -n inference patch hpa worker-gpu-pool-2 --patch '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":12}}'`
opsbot: scale request accepted, scaling up worker-gpu-pool-2 to 12 replicas.
alice: and temporarily reduce traffic to eu-west-1: `route set-region-priority eu-west-1 -1` (will shift new sessions).
maria: watching console metrics — token-level latency and kv-cache hit ratio.
devon: kv-cache hit rate dropped from 87% -> 30% around the spike start.
alice: looks like a cache-warm issue after a model rollout — model variant v2a has low cache affinity.
sre-lead: if cache miss is the root cause we should fallback to the previous model v1 while we stabilize.
devon: initiating rollback to infer-v1: `reconfigure-service --model-id infer-v1 --target all` -> started.
incident-bot: INC-4762 acknowledged by alice.
pagerduty: PagerDuty sent auto-resolve attempt at 07:18 UTC (no longer seeing threshold breach for configured window).
alice: auto-resolve fired but metrics still show elevated queuing; keeping thread open and monitoring.
maria: agree, this looks like flapping — let's suppress noisy pages temporarily for 10m while we apply fixes.
devon: PD alert fired again at 07:20 UTC for same metric (flap).
alice: ok it's flapping. Immediate plan: rollback (in progress), add sustained-window on alert, and ensure cache warm-up.
sre-lead: add quick mitigation: require 3m sustained p50 > 250ms before paging. I'll author the change.
alice: applying alert change (preview): `srectl alerts update infer-latency --sustained 180`
opsbot: alert change applied in staging (preview) — rolling to prod in 30s.
devon: rollback to infer-v1 complete, kv-cache warming — hit rate back up to ~82% after 2m.
alice: latency p50 back down to ~110ms, p95 stabilizing.
pagerduty: Alert INC-4762 cleared (auto-resolved) at 07:23 UTC.
maria: customer impact check: no 5xx surge, only higher latency; no customer-reported errors.
alice: post-incident notes: transient cache miss caused by model variant rollout + aggressive alert threshold -> flapping pages and noisy PD incidents.
devon: follow-ups: add preflight cache-warm step to model rollouts and document rollback playbook.
sre-lead: assign postmortem tasks: devon -> runbook for rollout cache warm, alice -> update alerting rules and PR to add sustained-window.
alice: ack — will file the runbook and create alerting PR.
maria: I'll maintain a 72h watch and set a temporary suppression policy for similar noise while PR merges.
alice: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread auto-archived after incident cleared.
